commands.name: password
commands.description: Search Pwned Passwords without sending a complete password or hash.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check passwords using local SHA-1 hashes and k-anonymity.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read one password line from stdin. The line terminator is excluded.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read one password per line from a UTF-8 text file.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Maximum concurrent file lookups. Defaults to logical processor count (minimum 2). Use 1 for sequential checks.

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Write Markdown results instead of JSON.

options.name: --outfile
options.description: Write results to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --fail-if-found
options.description: Exit with code 8 when results contain findings.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download all Pwned Passwords ranges for offline use. No API key is required.

options.name: --single
options.description: Write one ordered file of full hashes and counts.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Concurrent ranges. Values below 2 use the default: eight times the processor count, minimum 2.

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: Retries per range. Omit for unlimited retries; 0 disables retries.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Permit replacing an existing output file or ranges in a directory without an index.

options.name: --force
options.description: Ignore directory ETags, download all ranges, and rebuild the index.

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Write Markdown results instead of JSON.

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: Output directory, or output filename stem with --single (.txt is appended).
